errors.evidence: The pie chart has 10 sectors (slices), corresponding to the 10 categories with values greater than zero. The description incorrectly states there are 11.
The sector for "патенти" (patents) is dark teal, not dark blue. The dark blue sector represents "монографии" (monographs).
The sector for "книжни серии" (book series) is dark purple, not dark blue. The dark blue sector represents "монографии" (monographs).
The sector for "друго" (other) is brown/dark orange. The description calls it orange, which is the color used for a different category, "дисертации" (dissertations).

errors.text_span: Секторът „сива литература“ е зелен и има стойност 0.
errors.evidence: The category "сива литература" (grey literature) has a value of 0 and therefore does not have a corresponding sector in the pie chart. The description fabricates its existence and color.

errors.text_span: Секторът „хабилитационни трудове“ е оранжев и има стойност 0.
errors.evidence: The category "хабилитационни трудове" (habilitation theses) has a value of 0 and therefore does not have a corresponding sector in the pie chart. The description fabricates its existence and color.

errors.text_span: някои сектори са визуално подчертани с по-голям размер или по-силно изразен цвят
errors.evidence: No sectors in the pie chart are visually emphasized through size, color, or any other means. All slices are sized proportionally to their value.

errors.text_span: всички етикети са изразени вътре в секторите или с външни линии, свързани към тях
errors.evidence: All labels are located outside the pie chart and connected to their respective sectors with lines. None of the labels are inside the sectors.
